_comment: Stepwise-cumulative formation constants of metal-ligand complexes and ion pairs as equilibrium rows (E2 / A1): log10 beta_n at 25 C and zero ionic strength, reaction enthalpy dH (kJ/mol; null = not tabulated, taken as 0), tier and source per row. Generated by pipeline/db/build_complexes.py from the species reactions of the PHREEQC-format databases (minteq.v4, wateq4f, llnl, phreeqc, Thermoddem); rows marked Estimated are the earlier hand-typed values no database covers. A row is registered in a vessel when its metal and ligand are both present; ion pairs the table does not list are generated by Fuoss association (src/ion_pairing.rs).
